claims.claim: The proposal requests 420,000 ADA plus a 105,000 ADA contingency reserve for a part-time Oura maintainer over 12 months at an annual rate of $105,000 USD.
The budget summary lists 525,000 ADA for Oura maintenance and enhancement and 15,750 ADA for the Intersect Budget Administration fee, totaling 540,750 ADA.
Oura is described as a Rust-native pipeline tool that connects to Cardano nodes, monitors blockchain events, and routes matching patterns to pluggable outputs.
Oura is said to support multiple data sources including N2C, N2N, S3, Mithril, and UTxO RPC, and many sinks including Kafka, Elasticsearch, AWS services, RabbitMQ, Redis, SQL databases, and webhooks.
The document states that Oura has 654 commits, 288 stars, 79 forks, and 58 contributors, and links to the Oura GitHub repository.
The proposal states that Oura has been funded twice through Project Catalyst, in Fund 9 and Fund 13, for feature development.

The proposal states that it achieved the required 67% support threshold during the 2026 Intersect Budget Process Hydra Voting phase and provides references to Hydra voting and audited results materials.
The proposal states that the requested amount does not, at submission, alone or in aggregate breach the applicable 350M Net Change Limit covering Epoch 613 to Epoch 713.
The document states that independent oversight will be provided through Intersect and technically capable third parties, with reporting obligations and milestone-based disbursement controls.

The document states that TxPipe has received funding through 30 Project Catalyst proposals across Funds 9 through 14, with 26 successfully delivered and 4 under development and on schedule, and that Intersect-funded Pallas, Dolos, and UTxO RPC maintenance is on schedule.

summary: The anchor document requests 540,750 ADA to fund 12 months of Oura maintenance and enhancement through Intersect-administered treasury smart contracts, with stated budget breakdown, governance-process references, NCL compliance claim, oversight structure, and project-adoption claims.
